description: July 26 birthday meaning: Leo decan 1, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 26 birthday falls in Leo, in the first decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Sun as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: July 26 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Sun, Sun and 8: the 26th of July places the Sun in its own sign, in its own decan, three degrees into Leo, with the executive birthday number. Few birthdays are read as more naturally authoritative. The traditional portrait is a confident organiser with real presence, at its best when power is used generously and credit is shared widely.

On July 26 the Sun usually sits at about 3° Leo, in the first decan, where Sun rules the decan as well as the sign. With the Sun ruling both the sign and its first decan, late-July birthdays sit in the most radiant part of Leo. This is traditionally the decan of presence: warmth, self-expression and a natural pull towards the centre of the stage or the head of the table. Generosity and loyalty are often strong, and so is a need to be appreciated for the effort behind the performance. The doubled solar tone can tip into wounded pride when recognition is withheld. These Lions usually shine brightest when their light is used to warm a whole group rather than only to illuminate themselves.

sections.heading: July 26 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 26th reduces as 2 + 6 = 8. Here the 2's cooperative instinct and the 6's sense of responsibility build towards the 8's practical power. Twenty-sixth-born people are often described as capable organisers who lead through care, managing a household, a business or a community with both warmth and firmness. They tend to think about security for the people they love. As a secondary number, the 26 is traditionally associated with sound judgement in material matters. Balancing control with trust in others is often part of their path.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one July 26 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on July 26: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 26 is the 207th day of the year (208th in a leap year). By August 23, 28 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Virgo.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by July 26, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on July 26 include George Bernard Shaw (1856), Stanley Kubrick (1928) and Carl Jung (1875).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 26?
faq.answer: July 26 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Leo, which tradition links with Sun.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 26?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 26 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 26th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 26?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 26 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 26?
faq.answer: July 26 is also the birthday of George Bernard Shaw (1856), Stanley Kubrick (1928) and Carl Jung (1875). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
